item.title: Satin Creditcare Q2 profit surges over three-fold as asset quality improves
item.description: Satin Creditcare Network reported a more than three-fold rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 176 crore in the second quarter, helped by lower microfinance provisions, portfolio growth and improved asset quality. Its gross NPA ratio improved to 1.9% from 3.5% a year earlier, signalling a recovery from earlier stress.

item.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 net profit rises 41% on strong income growth, plans Rs 5000 crore capital raise
item.description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance reported a 41% rise in second-quarter net profit to Rs 1,630 crore, helped by strong income growth, higher loan disbursements and lower loan losses. The company’s board approved a proposal to raise up to Rs 5,000 crore through a qualified institutional placement.

item.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2 profit jumps 41% as scooter and EV sales surge
item.description: Hero MotoCorp’s Q2 FY27 consolidated profit rose 41% to Rs 1,860.55 crore, while revenue increased 23% to Rs 14,970.50 crore. Scooter sales surged 47%, VIDA retail sales grew 76%, and international expansion strengthened growth prospects.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
item.description: Indian markets closed lower on Wednesday as rising crude oil prices and Middle East tensions hurt sentiment. Sensex fell 353 points to 73,246, while Nifty slipped 51 points to 22,699 despite a late recovery.

item.title: Weak returns at home fuel India's overseas retail investing boom
item.description: Indian retail investors are increasingly venturing into global markets, significantly boosting their overseas investments. In response, domestic asset managers are introducing new funds to meet the rising demand for international exposure. With the Reserve Bank of India's limits on overseas investments nearing their cap, many investors are exploring tax-friendly locations like GIFT City.

item.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2 Results: Profit surges 41% YoY to Rs 1,861 crore, revenue jumps 23%
item.description: Hero MotoCorp’s Q2 FY27 consolidated profit rose 41% to Rs 1,861 crore, while revenue increased 23% to Rs 14,971 crore. Scooter sales, 100cc motorcycles and VIDA electric scooters boosted growth, alongside international expansion and investments.

item.title: Sebi to review FPI compliance norms, issue consultation paper to align with global standards
item.description: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated they will review compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors in India. A consultation paper will seek feedback on aligning these norms with global standards while ensuring investor protection. This initiative aims to enhance foreign investor participation in domestic markets and streamline access procedures. Additionally, Pandey emphasized the significance of domestic savings along with international capital to support market development.

item.title: Acutaas Chemicals among 5 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 18% in a month
item.description: Despite the Sensex falling 352 points to 73,246, five BSE 500 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs on Wednesday. PVR Inox, Acutaas Chemicals, Indian Hotels, Piramal Pharma and Sona BLW posted monthly gains of 9% to 18%.

item.title: Vedanta Aluminium Q2 Results: Profit doubles to Rs 6,187 crore, revenue jumps 41%
item.description: Vedanta Aluminium’s Q2 FY27 net profit surged 105% to Rs 6,187 crore, driven by record production, higher sales and improved realisations. Revenue rose 41%, EBITDA increased 83%, and net debt declined Rs 3,090 crore sequentially.

item.title: Sebi signs MoU with Bank of England to strengthen oversight of clearing corporations
item.description: SEBI and the Bank of England signed an MoU to strengthen regulatory cooperation and information sharing on clearing corporations. The framework supports cross-border supervision, enables reliance on SEBI’s oversight, and reinforces financial stability.

item.title: Bandhan Bank Q2 profit jumps 5.6 times as asset quality improves
item.description: Bandhan Bank reported a five-fold rise in Q2 profit to Rs 622 crore, supported by lower provisions and improving asset quality. Net interest income grew 14%, margins strengthened, gross advances increased 13%, and deposits rose 9% year-on-year.

item.title: Meesho Q2 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 132 crore YoY, revenue rises 34%
item.description: Meesho’s Q2 FY27 net loss narrowed 67.8% to Rs 132.45 crore, while revenue surged 34.4% to Rs 4,131.58 crore. Rising user engagement, stronger merchandise value, improved contribution margins and festive-season demand supported growth amid elevated spending.

item.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 profit falls 24% despite record sales
item.description: Hyundai Motor India’s Q2 FY27 net profit fell 24% to Rs 1,196.2 crore as commodity costs pressured margins. Revenue rose 19% to Rs 20,696.1 crore, supported by record sales, stronger exports and upcoming vehicle launches.

item.title: Anant Raj Q2 Results: Profit rises 13% to Rs 156 crore
item.description: Anant Raj Ltd has demonstrated robust financial performance, with a 13 percent rise in consolidated net profits for the September quarter. The company's total income surged to Rs 678.95 crore, up from Rs 640.89 crore the previous year. For the first half of the year, net profit climbed to Rs 305.68 crore, compared to Rs 264.08 crore, signaling its strong standing in the Indian real estate sector.

item.title: Vedanta Aluminium quarterly profit more than doubles on high prices, record production
item.description: Vedanta Aluminium reported a significant increase in its quarterly profit, which more than doubled from the previous year. The company's consolidated net profit rose to 51.67 billion rupees for the quarter ending September 30. Revenue from operations also increased by 40% during the same period, driven by elevated aluminium prices. Aluminium production hit a record of 649,000 metric tons, up 5% from last year.

item.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 Results: Profit surges 41% to Rs 1,630 crore; co plans to raise Rs 5,00O crore via QIP
item.description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company has reported an impressive 41 percent surge in net profit for the second quarter, marking Rs 1,630 crore, up from Rs 1,155 crore the previous year. Their total income significantly increased to Rs 9,367 crore, primarily fueled by rising interest income. Additionally, the company's gross non-performing assets improved to 3.29 percent, signaling enhanced asset quality.

item.title: TVS Motor Q2 Results: Profit jumps 52% YoY to Rs 1,377 crore; revenue rises 44%
item.description: TVS Motor Company reported a 52% rise in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,377 crore, with revenue up 44%. Record sales, electric two-wheeler growth and strategic acquisitions boosted performance, while shares gained 2.52% on the NSE.

item.title: Jio debuts on D-Street: India’s biggest IPOs delivered negative returns over one month after listing. Will Jio break the curse?
item.description: Jio Platforms has marked a significant milestone by successfully launching its market debut following India’s largest initial public offering, valued at Rs 30,213-crore. While historical trends indicate that stocks often experience negative returns post-major IPOs, initial reports present an optimistic outlook for Jio, with projections suggesting potential for growth as the company aims to expand its technological footprint through cutting-edge innovations across diverse sectors.

item.title: From 104 shareholders to nearly 80 lakh! Jio becomes India's most widely owned stock on listing day
item.description: Jio Platforms has become India’s most widely held listed stock, with 79.6 lakh shareholders following its blockbuster IPO, overtaking Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Reliance Industries and Vodafone Idea. From just 104 shareholders before the issue, Jio attracted over 1.38 crore applications and debuted at a market capitalisation of Rs 12.53 lakh crore.

item.title: MFs raise stake for 3 straight quarters in 5 mid-cap stocks; shares gain up to 75% YTD
item.description: Mutual funds steadily increased their holdings in 39 BSE midcap stocks for three consecutive quarters through September 2026. While five stocks gained 15–75% in CY26, several others declined sharply despite continued institutional buying.

item.title: Info Edge Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 93% YoY to Rs 334 crore, revenue rises 13%; co declares Rs 3/share interim dividend
item.description: Info Edge reported a sharp year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit due to a large exceptional gain in the previous year, while revenue and operating profit grew. Recruitment, 99acres and matchmaking businesses recorded healthy growth, alongside AI-led expansion.

item.title: Diwali 2026: Sensex plunged 10,000 points, Nifty dropped 12% since last Diwali. Will Samvat 2083 bring some relief?
item.description: Dalal Street heads into Samvat 2083 after a turbulent year that saw the Sensex plunge over 10,750 points and the Nifty shed nearly 12% since last Diwali. The Iran-US conflict, elevated crude oil prices, persistent FII outflows and AI-led IT selloff weighed on sentiment. Can easing headwinds revive the market?

item.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 Results: Standalone profit falls 24% YoY to Rs 1,189 crore, but revenue rises 18%
item.description: Hyundai Motors India has reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,189 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting a notable decrease of 24% compared to Rs 1,570 crore during the same period last year. However, their operational revenue has grown to Rs 20,191 crore, representing an 18% increase from Rs 17,061 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. This performance illustrates the company's resilience amidst shifting market conditions.

item.title: From Dhirubhai Ambani’s Rs 10 crore IPO to Akash Ambani’s Rs 12.5 lakh crore Jio debut: Reliance’s biggest wealth story
item.description: Jio Platforms’ Rs 12.5 lakh crore debut marks a new milestone in the Ambani family’s wealth creation journey, tracing Reliance’s evolution from its Rs 10 crore IPO in 1977 to a digital technology giant.

item.title: Vedanta Q2 Results: Profit zooms 78% YoY to Rs 6,202 crore; revenue surges 57%
item.description: Vedanta Q2 Results: Vedanta Ltd reported a 78% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 6,202 crore in the September quarter, while revenue increased 57% to Rs 26,356 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 9,938 crore, with margins improving to 60%. Higher commodity prices and increased production supported earnings, while net debt fell by Rs 4,624 crore to Rs 3,675 crore during the quarter.

item.title: Ambani bluechip bet gets bigger: Investors mark 82% of traded Jio shares for holding beyond listing
item.description: Jio Platforms saw nearly 82% of its traded volume marked for delivery on debut, with 10.66 crore shares carried into settlement out of 13.02 crore shares traded. The stock listed at a 21.36% premium to its IPO price, while Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Securities initiated coverage with Buy ratings.

item.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results: Revenue spikes 75% YoY to Rs 37,216 crore, profit at Rs 1,492 crore
item.description: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results 2026: Adani Enterprises has reported a 55% drop in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY27, with figures reaching Rs 1,492 crore compared to Rs 3,304 crore from the previous year. Conversely, operational revenue surged by 75%, hitting Rs 37,216 crore. This stark contrast is notable due to the previous year's inflated profits, driven by exceptional gains totaling Rs 3,583 crore, highlighting a dramatic shift in financial performance.

item.title: Jio effect! Reliance beats Tata to become India's most valued conglomerate
item.description: Jio Platforms’ listing has propelled the Reliance Group to become India’s most valuable conglomerate, with a combined market capitalisation of over Rs 28 lakh crore, surpassing the Tata Group. Jio debuted at Rs 1,358, a 21% premium to its IPO price of Rs 1,119, adding over Rs 12.5 lakh crore to Reliance Group’s market value.

item.title: Hyundai Motor Q2 Results Live Updates: Standalone profit at Rs 1189 cr vs Rs 1570 cr, down 24% YoY
Adani Ports Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 17% YoY to Rs 3,622 crore; revenue up 24%
item.description: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Adani Ports reported a 17% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 3,622 crore, while revenue grew 24% to Rs 11,340 crore. The company raised its FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance by Rs 1,000 crore each and increased its capex guidance by Rs 3,000 crore, citing strong first-half performance.

item.title: Jio Platforms delivers biggest listing gain among India’s 5 largest IPOs, jumps 21% on debut
item.description: Jio Platforms shares listed at a 21.35% premium to the IPO price of Rs 1,119, delivering the biggest listing-day gain among India’s five largest IPOs by issue size. Brokerages Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings, citing tariff hikes, subscriber monetisation and digital services growth.

item.title: Adani Green’s debt maths: Why leverage may fall below 4x as capex cycle matures
item.description: Adani Green Energy Limited is looking forward to a decrease in leverage as its upcoming projects start functioning and yield cash flow. With a substantial ₹2.4 lakh crore earmarked for capital expenditures by FY30, the company aims to enhance its renewable energy capacity. As project loans are paid off, leverage is expected to dip below four times.

item.title: Infosys, TechM, TCS, other IT stocks plunge up to 5%, extend losses as global AI trade rebounds. What lies ahead?
item.description: Indian IT stocks fell sharply on Wednsday as renewed optimism around the global AI trade weighed on sentiment. Strong earnings from SK Hynix and Anthropic’s IPO filing fuelled gains in AI-linked stocks globally. However, concerns over an AI bubble persist, with analysts highlighting a potential advantage for Indian IT services firms.

item.title: Weak domestic returns fuel India's overseas retail investing boom
item.description: Indian investors are turning to global funds as domestic market performance remains weak and opportunities abroad increase. A surge in overseas investments, particularly in AI-related assets, has been noted recently. Fund managers are launching various international funds to cater to this growing demand. Regulatory limits on overseas investments are in place, but tax-neutral hubs offer solutions.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki shares see target price cuts by Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages after Q2 net profit drops 26% YoY. What’s ahead?
item.description: Maruti Suzuki shares post marginal gains despite a 26% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 net profit. Jefferies, Nomura and Elara Capital lower their target prices, citing weaker margins and financial income, even as record sales volumes and strong revenue growth offer support.

item.title: TCS, Vedanta among 10 companies offering dividend yield of up to 7%. Do you own any?
item.description: Currently, numerous companies are enticing income-focused investors with impressive dividend yields. Notably, Vedanta and Coal India shine with a hefty 7% dividend yield. In comparison, Indian Oil Corporation and Bharat Petroleum offer more modest yields at 6%. Conversely, Tata Consultancy Services and HCL Technologies yield at around 4%, targeting distinct investor preferences. These firms highlight the significance of consistent dividend income for shareholders.

item.title: Subros shares surge 10% after securing Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply order from Maruti Suzuki
item.description: Subros shares surged up to 10% after securing a Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply contract from Maruti Suzuki for two vehicle models over approximately seven years. The award comes as the stock remains down around 45% over the past year.

item.title: 'Fully subscribed in 95 minutes’: Jio listing leaves with greater responsibility, says Akash Ambani
Isha Ambani says Jio IPO marks a promise, renews Dhirubhai Ambani’s trust with investors
item.description: Isha Ambani described Jio Platforms’ stock market debut as a promise to honour the trust of investors and customers, nearly five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Industries public. Jio’s Rs 30,200-crore IPO attracted over Rs 7 lakh crore in demand, with the stock listing at a 21.3% premium.

item.title: Smallcap stocks rally up to 21% in 2 days: Should you chase the rush or book profits?
item.description: In the last two trading sessions, smallcap stocks have experienced an impressive resurgence, with certain stocks posting significant gains. As investors weigh their options, they face the decision of whether to capitalize on this upswing or secure profits amidst growing caution. Technical analysts identify critical resistance levels, foreseeing possible pullbacks. They recommend partial profit-taking at these points while also highlighting several stocks with promising recovery signs for potential purchases.

item.title: United Breweries shares rally 14% after Q2FY27 profit jumps 191% YoY
item.description: United Breweries shares surged by 14.44% as the company announced a staggering 191% jump in net profit, now at Rs 135 crore for the September quarter of FY27. Additionally, net sales increased by 24% to reach Rs 2,537 crore, driven by strong premium beer sales. However, despite this impressive performance, the stock has seen a decline of about 30% over the previous year.

item.title: No. 2 on Day 1: How Jio Platforms broke India’s market cap hierarchy in debut trade
item.description: Jio Platforms made a blockbuster stock market debut, listing at a 21.3% premium over its IPO price of Rs 1,119 at Rs 1,358 on the BSE. With a market capitalisation of around Rs 12.5 lakh crore, it became India’s second-most valuable listed company after parent Reliance Industries, overtaking Bharti Airtel. The debut also made Jio India’s largest listed telecom company, placing it ahead of major players such as TCS, SBI and Bajaj Finance.

item.title: Jio Platforms shares get 3 Buy calls on Day 1 as Nomura, Motilal and Elara initiate coverage. Check target price
item.description: Jio Platforms debuted at a 21.36% premium to its IPO price on Wednesday, while Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings. Brokerages cited telecom leadership, tariff hikes, rising ARPU, digital services and improving cash flow as key growth drivers.

item.title: L&T shares rally 6% after Q2 net profit jumps 33% YoY. Why Jefferies cut target price?
item.description: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) shares rose sharply on Wednesday after the company reported a 33% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,202 crore. Jefferies retained its Buy rating but cut the target price to Rs 4,700, citing weaker-than-expected margins and factoring in lower estimates.

item.title: Akash Ambani announces Jio’s next big mission after data: Bring AI, cloud and space connectivity to every Indian
item.description: Jio Platforms made a strong stock market debut, listing at a 21.3% premium after its Rs 30,200 crore IPO was fully subscribed within 95 minutes. Managing Director Akash Ambani outlined Jio’s next phase of growth, focusing on democratising artificial intelligence, cloud computing, space connectivity and emerging digital technologies to transform lives across India.

item.title: Jio Platforms listing at BSE: 'Will create value for decades to come', says Akash Ambani
Jio makes its D-Street debut: What it means for Reliance Industries investors and the road ahead
item.description: Jio Platforms’ stock market debut has brought its standalone valuation into focus, raising questions about value unlocking for Reliance Industries shareholders. Analysts weigh the outlook for Jio and RIL, the holding-company discount, and the growth drivers shaping their investment cases.

item.title: Jio after listing: 5 factors that could drive big returns for long-term investors
item.description: Jio Platforms recently debuted on the stock market with a strong initial premium over its IPO price. The company is well-positioned for growth due to its largest subscriber base and potential market expansion. Increased revenue can also result from higher average revenue per user and upcoming tariff hikes. Additionally, Jio's ventures into home broadband, AI, and cloud services present new revenue opportunities.

item.title: UPL among 3 stocks closing above VWAP
item.description: UPL, Prime Focus and Premier Energies featured in StockEdge’s VWAP scan on October 27, with closing prices more than 2% above their respective volume-weighted average prices.

item.title: HUL Q2 Results: Net profit rises 4% YoY to Rs 2,790 crore; Rs 19/share dividend declared
item.description: HUL Q2 Results: Hindustan Unilever reported a 4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 2,790 crore, while revenue grew 15% to Rs 18,226 crore. The FMCG major declared an interim dividend of Rs 19 per share and expects performance to improve in FY27, though near-term commodity inflation remains a concern.
